metric_definitions.return_ytd: NAV on 2026-10-07 / NAV on or before 2025-12-31 - 1
metric_definitions.return_1y: NAV on 2026-10-07 / NAV on or before 2025-10-07 - 1; start point must be within 7 days before cutoff
metric_definitions.return_5y_cagr: NAV-derived annualized return using a start NAV on or before 2021-10-07; start point must be within 7 days before cutoff
metric_definitions.max_drawdown_1y: Worst NAV-to-running-peak decline in the one-year window through 2026-10-07; start point must be within 7 days before cutoff

limitations: Metrics are derived from historical NAV and are not necessarily identical to provider-published metrics.
No same-date 931-fund cross-sectional rank is calculated.
Only observations on or before the reference date are used.
This artifact does not create or backfill rank history.
